<thought>We need a template that breaks an alkyl halide (functional group “alkyl halide”) and forms a primary amine (functional group “primary amines”). We'll search the catalog with those criteria and then apply the found template to the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["alkyl halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["primary amines"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
